build_cast_preprocessor: build a CastPreprocessor to cast all observations, reward and discount to np.float32 dtype
build_downcast_float_preprocessor: build a DowncastFloatPreprocessor to downcast float64 observations to float32 without touching uint8 images
build_stack_observations: build a StackObservations preprocessor to stack robot joint observations with depth 3 for n-step Markov environments
build_crop_and_resize: build a CropSquareAndResize preprocessor to crop a square region from an image and resize to 84x84 pixels
build_add_observation: build an AddObservation preprocessor to inject a custom callable-generated observation into each timestep
